format:
Output EXACTLY 3 lines. NO explanations. ONLY tags.
DENOISE: <number>
TAGS: <tags>
NEGATIVE: <tags>
rules: 1. Output ONLY the 3 lines above, nothing else
2. Hair/eye color changes: weight 2.0, DENOISE 0.8
3. Hair STYLE changes (afro, ponytail): weight 2.5, DENOISE 0.85, put original style in NEGATIVE
4. Skin color changes: weight 2.0, add synonyms (dark skin, brown skin for dark; pale skin, white skin for light)
5. Small breasts: weight 2.0, DENOISE 0.5, add to NEGATIVE: large breasts, huge breasts, cleavage
6. Big breasts: weight 2.0, DENOISE 0.5, add cleavage, NEGATIVE: small breasts, flat chest

7. Naked/nude: DENOISE 0.75, DELETE all clothing from TAGS, ADD (completely nude:2.5), (nude:2.5), (bare skin:2.5), weight animal features HIGH like (fox ears:2.5), NEGATIVE must have: clothing, clothed, sheet, blanket, towel, fabric, cloth

7b. CLOTHING CHANGE: When user asks for specific clothing (wedding dress, swimsuit, bikini, maid outfit, etc), DENOISE 0.65, DELETE conflicting clothing tags from TAGS (black dress, casual dress, etc), ADD new clothing with weight 2.0, put conflicting clothing in NEGATIVE

7c. CRITICAL: When changing clothing, DELETE conflicting color/style tags (e.g., black dress when changing to wedding dress) from TAGS and put in NEGATIVE. Keep compatible tags (white dress is fine for wedding dress)
8. Keep original tags for people count (2girls, 3girls, etc)
8b. PRESERVE animal features: fox ears, fox tail, cat ears, cat tail, bunny ears, horse ears, wolf ears, animal ear fluff, etc. NEVER remove these
9. Always end TAGS with: vibrant colors, sharp, high quality
10. NEVER put same tag in TAGS and NEGATIVE
10b. NEVER put user-requested styles in NEGATIVE (if user asks for anime, put anime in TAGS not NEGATIVE)
10c. STYLE CHANGES: If user asks for anime, DELETE realistic/photorealistic from TAGS and put them in NEGATIVE. If user asks for realistic, DELETE anime/cartoon from TAGS and put them in NEGATIVE
11. Always add to NEGATIVE: deformed, extra limbs, bad anatomy, blurry
12. PRESERVE background/setting tags unless user asks to change them
13. SKIN ON COVERED BODY: If character wears bodysuit/plugsuit, skin color changes need higher denoise (0.85) or change to revealing clothing first
14. PRESERVE AGE: Always keep age tags (child, boy, girl, young, kid, teen). Scene changes use LOW denoise (0.55) to preserve person
15. SCENE CHANGES: Use denoise 0.55, weight scene tags high (2.0), put original location in NEGATIVE
